paite: TOUPA na Pathian uh tapate na hi ua; misi ziak in na ki-atkeh ding uh ahi kei. Na mitmul uh leng na metmai ding uh ahi sam kei hi.
heading: Phal Louh Kisunna Dan
english: You are the children of Yahweh your God. You shall not cut yourselves, nor make any baldness between your eyes for the dead.

paite: TOUPA na Pathian a ding in nam siangthou na hi uh. Leitung a nam tengteng tung ah amah a tuam mawng hi dia TOUPA'N hon tel na hi uhi.
english: For you are a holy people to Yahweh your God, and Yahweh has chosen you to be a people for his own possession, above all peoples who are on the face of the earth.

paite: Thilkihhuai himhim na ne ding uh ahi kei.
heading: Sa Siang Leh Siang Lou / (Lev 11.1-47)
english: You shall not eat any abominable thing.

paite: Hiai sate ahi, na nek theih ding uh: Bawngtal, belam, kel,
english: These are the animals which you may eat: the ox, the sheep, the goat,

paite: sakhi, sangai, sakhital, sathak, gamkel, gamlawi leh gam belam.
english: the deer, the gazelle, the roebuck, the wild goat, the ibex, the antelope, and the chamois.

paite: Sa chiteng, achin ka, achin ka paisuak, eknel hai chi peuhmah na ne thei ding uh.
english: Every animal that parts the hoof, and has the hoof split in two and chews the cud, among the animals, you may eat.

paite: Himahleh eknel hai lel leh achin uh leng ka ngalte, na nek ding uh ahi kei. Sangawngsau, zupi leh zusapi in eknel ahai na ua, achin uh akat louh ziak in nou a ding in siang lou ahi uh.
english: Nevertheless these you shall not eat of them that chew the cud, or of those who have the hoof split: the camel, the hare, and the rabbit. Because they chew the cud but don’t part the hoof, they are unclean to you.

paite: Vok ahihleh achin aka na a, eknel ahai louh ziak in nou a ding in siang lou ahi; asa na ne ding uh ahi kei a, asiluang leng na khoih ding uh ahi kei.
english: The pig, because it has a split hoof but doesn’t chew the cud, is unclean to you. You shall not eat their meat. You shall not touch their carcasses.

paite: Tui a tengte lak ah hiaite na ne thei ding uh: phe leh lip nei peuhmah na ne thei ding uhi.
english: These you may eat of all that are in the waters: you may eat whatever has fins and scales.

paite: Phe leh lip nei lou peuhmahte na ne thei kei ding uh, nou a ding in siang lou ahi uh.
english: You shall not eat whatever doesn’t have fins and scales. It is unclean to you.

paite: Vasa siang tengteng na ne thei ding uh.
english: Of all clean birds you may eat.

paite: Hiaite zaw na ne ding uh ahi kei: Muvanlai, mungawnggiau, mu-akla;
english: But these are they of which you shall not eat: the eagle, the vulture, the osprey,

paite: musane, mumeika, mu chi himhim;
english: the red kite, the falcon, the kite of any kind,

paite: va-ak chi himhim;
english: every raven of any kind,

paite: simbu, zan mu, mu chi himhim, tuipi mu;
english: the ostrich, the owl, the seagull, the hawk of any kind,

paite: simbu neu, simbu lian, simbutanglip;
english: the little owl, the great owl, the horned owl,

paite: gamdai simbu, musane, vangawngsau;
english: the pelican, the vulture, the cormorant,

paite: Tuiva kengsang, tuivapi chi himhim, huihtun leh bak.
english: the stork, the heron after its kind, the hoopoe, and the bat.

paite: Kha nei khe a pai chi himhim nou a ding in siang lou ahi uh, nek ding ahi kei.
english: All winged creeping things are unclean to you. They shall not be eaten.

paite: Vasa siang tengteng na ne thei ding uh.
english: Of all clean birds you may eat.

paite: Amah sih a si bangmah na nek ding uh ahi kei. Na ompih uh gamdang mite nek ding in na pe thei ding uh. Namdang mite kiang ah leng na zuak thei ding uh. Nou zaw TOUPA na Pathian uh a ding in nam siangthou na hi uhi. Kelnou api nawitui in na huan ding uh ahi kei.
english: You shall not eat of anything that dies of itself. You may give it to the foreigner living among you who is within your gates, that he may eat it; or you may sell it to a foreigner; for you are a holy people to Yahweh your God. You shall not boil a young goat in its mother’s milk.

paite: Kum chih in na lou ua an tung tengteng sawm-a-khat na piak ngeingei ding uh ahi.
english: You shall surely tithe all the increase of your seed, that which comes out of the field year by year.

paite: TOUPA na Pathian uh laudan siamna dan na hon theihgige theihna ding un sawm-a-khat, na buh uh, na uain uh, na thau uh leh na ganhon uh leh na belamhon lak ua piang masapente TOUPA na Pathian uh ma ah, amin omna dia aseh ding ah na ne ding uhi.
english: You shall eat before Yahweh your God, in the place which he chooses to cause his name to dwell, the tithe of your grain, of your new wine, and of your oil, and the firstborn of your herd and of your flock; that you may learn to fear Yahweh your God always.

paite: TOUPA na Pathian un hon vualzawl chiang in, TOUPA na Pathian un amin omna dia aseh ding mun agamlat luat ziak a nou a dia alampi asau luat a, na tawi theih kei uleh,
english: If the way is too long for you, so that you are not able to carry it because the place which Yahweh your God shall choose to set his name there is too far from you, when Yahweh your God blesses you,

paite: sum na suah ding ua, sum na tawi ding ua, TOUPA na Pathian un amun sehna ah na hoh ding uh ahi.
english: then you shall turn it into money, bind up the money in your hand, and shall go to the place which Yahweh your God shall choose.

paite: Na lungsim ua na deihpen uh, bawngtal hiam, belam hiam, uain hiam, zu khauh hiam, na lungsim ua na lunggulh peuhmah uh a ding in sum na zang ding ua; huai ah TOUPA na Pathian uh ma ah na ne ding ua, kipaktak in na om ding uh; noute leh na inkote uh toh.
english: You shall trade the money for whatever your soul desires: for cattle, or for sheep, or for wine, or for strong drink, or for whatever your soul asks of you. You shall eat there before Yahweh your God, and you shall rejoice, you and your household.

paite: Na tenna ua teng Levite limsak lou in om het kei un. Na lak uah amau tantuan leh goutan anei kei uhi.
heading: Sawm-a-khat Piakdan
english: You shall not forsake the Levite who is within your gates, for he has no portion nor inheritance with you.

paite: Kum thum achin kum in huai kum a na thil tung tengteng ua sawm-a-khat na lakhawm vek ding ua, na omna uah na koih ding uh ahi.
english: At the end of every three years you shall bring all the tithe of your increase in the same year, and shall store it within your gates.

paite: Na omna ua om Levite leng, na lak ua tantuan, goutan leng neiloute leh gamdang mite leh pa neiloute leh meithaite'n ane ding ua, ahong khosa thei sam ding uhi. Huchi in TOUPA na Pathian un na khut koihna teng uh avualzawl ding hi.
english: The Levite, because he has no portion nor inheritance with you, as well as the foreigner living among you, the fatherless, and the widow who are within your gates shall come, and shall eat and be satisfied; that Yahweh your God may bless you in all the work of your hand which you do.
